title: Data Acquisition and Reconciliation Operations, Officer
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
 In this role, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead Reconciliation team supporting State street Middle Office and back office services. You will have responsibility to oversee and deliver all day\-to\-day deliverables of the Reconciliation management team in a fast\-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Reconciliation team. This Reconciliation Officer/Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible performing Cash, Position and Non\-Core reconciliation and support various functional teams to resolve the exception within SLA. The candidate should be a hands on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
* Oversee and provide day to day management of Reconciliation Management team for responsible Reconciliation unit/client
* Drive Reconciliation process excellence though proactive management of the exception lifecycle
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Conduct high\-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work\-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform an review function of Reconciliation process to identifying operational trends, issues and areas for improvement.
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.
* Support and proactive manage on Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models
* Communicate effectively on issues / problems to the Client and to SSC management and ensure a proper and timely follow\-up to ensure resolution.
* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze on the spot.


**What We Value**
* Extensive asset management experience, including investment operations, reconciliations and fund accounting.
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working in a variety of asset management disciplines.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Hands\-on experience with reconciliation tools like TLP/IntelliMatch and proficiency in manual reconciliation processes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to audiences of different sizes and levels of seniority
* Must be self\-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
* Good team working skills.
* Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Degree in finance, business, technology or equivalent with 10\+ yrs. of relevant industry experience
* Proven experience in client communication and interaction at all levels
* In depth understanding of Middle or Back Office operations, end\-to\-end processes of Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, ETFs, and other investment vehicles. Should be proficient in multiple asset classes including derivatives, bank loans, fixed income, OTC products, etc., and have a deep understanding of their life cycles.
* Understanding of key technology within the support of investment management operations, TLM/TLP and Intellimatch.
* Experience of driving organizational change, with an understanding of change management principles, techniques \& tools.
* Experience in leveraging technology solutions including low\-code tools, SQL, Python or similar is advantageous
* Strong MS Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint skills necessary


**Additional requirements :** 
 Working from office 4 days a week
   

  

**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Manager-Network Operations
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 As the Network Repair Bureau (NRB) Senior Manager, you will manage customer related issues as they relate to network experiences. You will be responsible for assuring day to day management of network customer issues and ensuring an optimal experience for our customers. This role leads a team of expert network engineers, Supervisors, and Principal Engineers working 24x7x365 supporting consumer and business customers. This includes managing the overall workload and focus on strengthening workforce skills through training as well as organizing and scheduling the resources necessary to support a broad range of network services. Manage customer escalations to ensure timely troubleshooting and issue resolution of Verizon network issues with various internal fix agents and vendors.
   

  

* Utilizing data analytics to drive efficiencies to the ticket handling process and queue management.
* Collaborating effectively with partner teams to lead strategic projects that drive and influence the future of the business.
* Performing regular data analysis to track performance (KPIs) and provide timely responses to employees and senior leadership teams
* Utilizing comprehensive understanding of the Network Repair Bureau (NRB)
* Ensuring that resources are properly staffed to manage the expected workload
* Partnering across peer teams to drive expectations around deliverables
* Enabling an inclusive culture focused on driving an environment or innovation, appreciation, and delivering on results
* Interacting with a variety of Verizon personnel at all levels of the organization, as well as interfacing with many different customers
* Managing escalations with a sense of urgency with the goal to restore and resolve customer while providing periodic executive updates as needed


**What We’re Looking For...**
**You'll need to have:**
* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Experience leading teams, managing customer escalations and collaborating cross functionally with the stakeholders.
* Experience with tactical and strategic plans for short term vs. long term business needs.
* Data orientation and addressing productivity concerns.
* Coaching, feedback and teamwork skills
* Must work a 24/7 shift schedule, including nights and weekends as necessary.
* Provide on\-call support, including weekend coverage.


**Even Better If You Have**
* A Masters degree.
* Ability to adapt to change – openness to different viewpoints and ability to learn new skills and concepts as our network transforms.
* Knowledge of call flow for a voice and/or data session describing network elements from cell to Internet.
* Knowledge of wireless cell site base station, router and antenna equipment.
* Experience in the use of circuit and RAN test equipment and network monitoring applications.
* Strong RF Network Performance or Networking experience.
* Service provider experience in MSC and/or Cell Operations and Maintenance.


 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
   

  

 Scheduled Weekly Hours
   

  

 40
   

  

 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Manager - Network Operations & Support
description:

 Network Operations \& Support \- DDI \& Load Balancer (IP Services)

 The Manager – IP Services role provides technical leadership and governance for enterprise IP services and application delivery platforms.  Any degree or relevant education is must. This role requires working at customer locations based on business needs.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – RESTAURANT MANAGER**




  





**Position:** 
 Restaurant Manager – Operations \& Business Development
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai
 



**Department:** 
 Restaurant / F\&B Operations
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Management
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for a dynamic, experienced, and business\-oriented
 **Restaurant Manager** 
 to take complete responsibility for the day\-to\-day operations and business growth of our restaurant branches in Chennai.
 



 The ideal candidate should be capable of
 **independently managing restaurant operations, driving sales and profitability, developing new business opportunities, and strengthening the brand’s presence through social media, influencers, and local marketing initiatives** 
 .
 



 The candidate should have strong knowledge of the Chennai F\&B market and established contacts with
 **food influencers, content creators, and local promotional networks** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Restaurant Operations** 



* Take complete responsibility for the smooth and efficient operation of assigned restaurant branches.
* Ensure high standards of
 **food quality, service, hygiene, ambience, and customer experience** 
 .
* Manage and motivate restaurant staff, including recruitment, training, scheduling, performance monitoring, and discipline.
* Monitor daily sales, expenses, inventory, wastage, and operational costs.
* Ensure proper stock control, purchase coordination, and reduction of food and material wastage.
* Monitor billing, cash handling, POS operations, and daily closing procedures.
* Handle customer feedback and complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Implement and maintain restaurant SOPs and operational standards across branches.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, safety, and statutory requirements.



**Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Take ownership of
 **sales and revenue growth** 
 for the assigned restaurant branches.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase
 **customer footfall, repeat customers, average order value, and overall profitability** 
 .
* Identify new revenue opportunities, promotional activities, events, partnerships, and local marketing initiatives.
* Analyse sales trends, customer preferences, competition, and market opportunities in Chennai.
* Develop branch\-wise business plans and execute initiatives to achieve sales targets.
* Explore opportunities for
 **corporate orders, catering, events, food delivery, collaborations, and other revenue channels** 
 .
* Monitor competitor restaurants and recommend new products, offers, pricing, and promotional strategies.
* Work closely with the management to identify opportunities for expansion and business development.



**Social Media \& Influencer Management** 



* Take an active role in developing and strengthening the restaurant’s
 **social media presence** 
 .
* Manage and coordinate content for platforms such as
 **Instagram and Facebook** 
 .
* Plan and execute engaging content including
 **reels, food photography, stories, offers, events, customer experiences, and promotional campaigns** 
 .
* Maintain good relationships with
 **food bloggers, influencers, content creators, and local social media personalities** 
 .
* Identify suitable influencers and negotiate/coordinate collaborations to increase restaurant visibility and footfall.
* Plan influencer visits, product launches, promotional campaigns, and social media activities.
* Monitor social media comments, reviews, messages, and customer feedback and ensure appropriate responses.
* Track social media performance and evaluate the effectiveness of influencer and promotional campaigns.
* Stay updated on
 **Chennai food trends, viral content, customer preferences, and emerging marketing opportunities** 
 .



**Branch Management \& Business Development** 



* Visit and monitor different restaurant branches regularly.
* Ensure consistency in
 **food quality, service standards, customer experience, and brand presentation** 
 across branches.
* Identify operational gaps and take corrective action.
* Support new branch launches and ensure smooth implementation of operations.
* Develop branch\-level strategies based on the location, customer profile, and market potential.
* Build relationships with local businesses, corporates, event organisers, influencers, and other potential business partners.
* Take ownership of initiatives that can improve the restaurant's
 **brand visibility, customer base, and profitability** 
 .



**Candidate Profile** 



* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in
 **Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Management, or a related field** 
 .
* **10 years of experience** 
 in restaurant/F\&B operations, preferably with experience managing an independent restaurant or multiple branches.
* Strong understanding of
 **restaurant operations and business development** 
 .
* Good knowledge of the
 **Chennai restaurant/F\&B market** 
 .
* Should have existing or demonstrable experience in dealing with
 **food influencers, bloggers, content creators, and local marketing networks** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **Instagram, Facebook, reels, social media promotions, and influencer marketing** 
 .
* Should be commercially oriented and capable of converting marketing initiatives into business results.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and people\-management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Willingness to travel between restaurant branches in Chennai.



**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Branch\-wise sales and revenue growth
* Customer footfall and repeat customer percentage
* Restaurant profitability and cost control
* Food and material wastage
* Customer satisfaction and online ratings
* Staff productivity and retention
* Social media reach and engagement

**Key Competencies** 




**Restaurant Operations \| Business Development \| Sales Growth \| P\&L Awareness \| Team Management \| Customer Experience \| Influencer Management \| Social Media Marketing \| Local Marketing \| Negotiation \| Cost Control \| Problem Solving \| Leadership**

description:

 Engineering

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

 Manages the Hydraulic Mining Shovel value chain and resource planning by working with logistics, operations, product and process engineering, product support, and lifecycle management teams to optimize supply chain resiliency, lead time, and cost.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Managing staffing, development, and performance management programs for value chain engineering teams; motivating and developing project and team leaders.

description:

 Senior Manager
   

  

 As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large\-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end\-to\-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning.
   

  

 You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large\-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Deloitte's Health Care Provider practice helps hospital and health system clients design, implement, optimize, and stabilize Epic and other electronic medical record (EMR) platforms as part of broader digital and clinical transformation programs. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead our offshore Epic delivery teams, acting as the connective layer between onshore client\-facing leadership and our India\-based build, testing, and support teams.
   

  

 This is a delivery leadership role — you will own workstream execution, team management, and quality for one or more Epic modules/applications across engagements, while helping mature our offshore Epic capability.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead offshore delivery for Epic EMR workstreams (e.g., Ambulatory, Inpatient/ClinDoc, Cadence, Prelude/ADT, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Grand Central, Radiant, HIM, or Payer platforms) across implementation, optimization, upgrade, and application managed services (AMS) engagements.
* Manage a team of Epic analysts, builders, and testers (typically 60–80\+ FTEs), including staffing, performance management, mentoring, and career development.
* Own workstream execution — build plans, Incidents/SRs, small and large enhancements— ensuring on\-time, on\-quality delivery against client\-agreed scope and adhering to client’s processes.
* Partner with client and onshore engagement leadership to translate client requirements, workflows, and design decisions into actionable offshore work packages.
* Drive governance and reporting — status updates, RAID logs, capacity/utilization tracking, and escalation management across time zones.
* Ensure Epic build quality and compliance with client governance, Epic's own standards (e.g., Epic's Storyboard/Chronicles environment practices), and Deloitte delivery methodology.
* Support pre\-sales and proposal efforts , including offshore staffing plans, effort estimation, and delivery approach for new pursuits.
* Contribute to offshore practice development — recruiting, training curricula, reusable accelerators, and knowledge management.
* Manage stakeholder relationships across US/onshore client teams, and internal Deloitte leadership.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of total IT/consulting experience, with 6\+ years dedicated to Epic EMR implementation, optimization, or support.
* Proven experience managing offshore or globally distributed teams on Epic engagements, including cross\-time\-zone delivery models.
* Hands\-on depth in at least one major Epic application area (Ambulatory, Inpatient, ClinDoc, Cadence/Prelude, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Radiant, HIM, or Tapestry/Payer), with working knowledge of adjacent modules.
* Active or recent Epic certification(s) in a relevant module (certification lapses acceptable if recency and/or depth are demonstrated).
* Experience across the full ITSM delivery activities: Incidents, SRs, changes, tasks and projects/enhancements with associated build, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-live stabilization activities
* Strong people leadership — staffing, performance reviews, coaching, and building bench strength in an offshore delivery center.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to onshore client and Deloitte leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Health Informatics, Life Sciences, or related); Master's preferred.
* Flexibility to work overlapping hours with US client teams as needed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience at a Big 4 or major healthcare IT consulting firm.
* Multiple Epic certifications or other EMR experience
* Exposure to Epic upgrades (e.g., version migrations), or multi\-hospital rollouts.
* Familiarity with adjacent healthcare IT domains: HL7/FHIR interoperability, revenue cycle, clinical informatics, or population health.
* Experience with Agile/hybrid delivery methodologies and tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).

 📍 Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



  





 Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI) is looking for an experienced and dynamic \*Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)\* to lead the overall administrative and operational functions of our Kodambakkam campus.
 



  





 The CAO will play a key leadership role in ensuring
 **efficient campus operations, infrastructure management, safety, security, facilities, procurement, vendor management and administrative governance.**

 **safety, discipline, service quality and operational efficiency** 
 .

 \* Lead the overall administrative operations of the campus.

 \* Coordinate effectively with the Principal, COO, HODs and functional heads.

title: Project SCM Manager - HVDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
 HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements, and standard compliance is very high. Hitachi Energy is seeking Project Managers – Supply Chain for Chennai location. This is a great opportunity to apply your passion for project management to manage million\-dollar projects!
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role, responsible for SCM (Supply Chain Management) in the Project, reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager while supporting the project director. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem\-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing the SCM scope of large projects close to the end customer. We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* In this role you will be Project Manager within the HVDC SCM project and responsible for the procurement activities in our HVDC projects.
* You will be part of the HVDC Project Core team for the projects you manage.
* In this role, you will coordinate across multiple global regions with engineers, controllers, project planners, logisticians, quality professionals, buyers, and suppliers to ensure that equipment is procured and delivered on time, within budget, and within standard.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all key personnel within the project, global supply chain, the HVDC organization, and the client are aware of any risks and opportunities within project supply chain.
* During the project execution Project SCM need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow\-up all equipment delivers with our suppliers and internal stakeholders. Project SCM to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
* Contribute to vendor list management by providing Supplier Performance data. Ensure that our suppliers comply with the laws, regulations, standards, certificates and directives that Hitachi Energy requires from their suppliers.
* You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering with preferably 12\+ years relevant work experience and master's in business administration is added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the supply chain management needs of multi\-million dollar projects.
* Strong organizational and planning skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proactively address business demands in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize and allocate resources to align with department and company goals.
* Preferred CPSM or PMP certifications, Lean Six Sigma, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to create strong working relationships.

title: Global Billing Operations - Manager
description:
**Background**
 State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business\-as\-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation.
   

  

**Basic Purpose Of Job**
 The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries \& regions.
   

  

 The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day\-to\-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.
   

  

 In addition to Business As Usual (BAU) responsibilities as described above, this role will also be involved in process re\-engineering, standardization, and automation efforts.
   

  

 Responsibilities:\-
   

  

**Business As Usual (BAU) Activities**
* General responsibility for all operational invoicing activities
* End\-to\-end responsibility for a major group of the billing process: Invoice preparation and review
* Oversee and manage the invoice review team to achieve global consistency and effectiveness in controls; accurate, quality work; and transparency into activities and results. Maintain a robust control environment: process controls, process oversight and process governance responsibility
* Develop the team to adopt “owner’s mind set”, work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage resources to assist with ad\-hoc invoice projects
* Measure progress toward goals; and evaluate productivity and team efficiency. Review and assess regularly with team members and with management
* May serve as a subject matter expert on particular invoice related issues
* Coaches the team and gathers feedback for performance appraisals


**Process Re\-Engineering, Standardization, And Automation**
* Assist with the process Re\-Engineering, Standardization, and Automation efforts for invoicing
* Responsible for ongoing process improvements


**Expectations**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree in Finance, CPA Qualified with an experience minimum of 10 to 12 years working with invoices in a global billing function at a large financial services institution.
* Knowledge of various services and industry trends of billing methods for those services like Custody services, Sub custodian, trust services and out pocket expense billing, asset management etc.
* Experience of building and maintaining strong control environment (risk excellence, experience with SOX, RCSA controls, etc.), establishing policies, procedures and strong internal controls.
* Demonstrated leadership in improving/building\-out the invoice function for multiple geographies and business areas
* Experience assisting with re\-engineering processes and driving similar centralization of the end\-to\-end activities for the major financial institutions


**Skills Required**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word, Visio), advance levels of Excel (pivot tables, formulas, excel workbook maintenance best practices)
* Knowledge of billing systems
* Conceptual understanding of company\-wide financial architecture (GL, sub\-GL technology, specialized tools) applicable to the above process groups of processes
* First level management expertise required
* Independent decision\-making capabilities, demonstrated thought leadership
* Pride of ownership with the ability to deliver high quality results timely
* Self\-motivated, self\-assured, and self\-managed
* Strong analytical and ability to analyze and summarize complex financial transactions
* Strong attention to details
* Problem solving skill
* Highly organized with ability to multi\-task and work under high pressure deadlines
* Must be able to work in a fast paced environment


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**About Metayb**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. We have grown into a close\-knit family of
 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Supply Chain Manager** 
 to manage and coordinate end\-to\-end
 **logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations** 
 across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on
 **Saudi Arabia and Egypt** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the
 **Head of Logistics** 
 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations.
* Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions.
* Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15–20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments.
* Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred.
* Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred.
* Arabic\-speaking candidates will be given priority.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination.
* Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems.
* Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region.
* Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets.
* Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners.
* Strong exposure to SAP\-based supply chain and logistics operations.
* Arabic language proficiency.
* Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership.

* Foster a positive, collaborative, and conflict\-free work culture.

title: Head of Physiotherapy (Clinical Lead)
description:
ABOUT VECURA
   

 VeCura is a doctor\-led wellness and metabolic health clinic chain with 30\+ branches across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, and more coming. We treat 35,000\+ clients a year through structured programmes combining lifestyle, diet, device and physiotherapy. Muscle health and mobility are becoming central to how we care for clients, and we're building that function from the ground up.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 You will own physiotherapy across the VeCura network. You'll design and standardise our Physio module and train every branch physiotherapist to deliver both consistently. You'll also be the public face of physiotherapy at VeCura, explaining movement, strength and healthy ageing on camera to a large social media audience.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO
   

 Clinical leadership
   

 • Own the Physio module in every VeCura programme: assessment battery, session protocols, progression rules and outcome measures
   

 • Co\-develop programmes with our medical team
   

 • Define contraindications, red flags and escalation pathways with the medical team, and keep protocols evidence\-based and clinically defensible
   

 • Audit protocol adherence and outcomes across branches, then fix the gaps
   

 Training and team building
   

 • Build the physio training curriculum: onboarding, module certification and periodic refreshers
   

 • Train and mentor branch physiotherapists, in person and virtually
   

 • Set quality standards and documentation norms, and run case reviews
   

 Content and communication
   

 • Appear regularly on VeCura's social media channels (reels, explainers, Q\&A, live sessions)
   

 • Work with the marketing team to plan, script and shoot content on mobility, strength, posture and healthy ageing
   

 • Keep all public messaging accurate, responsible and free of exaggerated claims
   

 • Support client education material and occasional workshops or corporate talks
   

  

 WHAT YOU BRING (MUST\-HAVE)
   

 • BPT required; MPT (Musculoskeletal, Neuro, Sports or Geriatrics) strongly preferred
   

 • 7\+ years of clinical experience, including at least 2 years leading or training a team of physiotherapists
   

 • Proven on\-camera experience: social media content, YouTube, TV, webinars or brand videos. Please share links.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with strength and balance rehab in older adults or musculoskeletal populations
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication in English and Tamil
   

 • Ability to turn clinical protocols into simple, repeatable SOPs that others can follow
   

  

 GOOD TO HAVE
   

 • Certification or training in fall\-prevention programmes (e.g., Otago), sarcopenia assessment or geriatric rehab
   

 • Familiarity with EMS, body composition analysis (InBody) or strength testing
   

 • Experience in a multi\-branch clinic chain or a structured training role
   

 • Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam knowledge is a plus
   

 • An existing personal following as a health educator
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

 • A leadership role building a network\-wide function from scratch
   

 • Direct access to corporate leadership and the medical team
   

 • A platform to build your public profile as a trusted physiotherapy voice
   

 • Competitive compensation

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
**Job Description**
 Cost Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain project cost budgets in accordance with the Project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and the Basis of Estimate
* Liaise with procurement, finance, and time\-capture functions to ensure accurate and timely capture of all cost elements — procurement, materials, subcontracts, and labour
* Monitor and review cost commitments and expenditure through all phases of project lifecycle
* Liaise with project management and planning to ensure accuracy of cost phasing and forecasting
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports and forecast updates
* Review and analyse cost impact of manpower forecasts
* Review and issue project change orders and variations in accordance with change notifications
* Assess and communicate cost and schedule impact of change notifications
* Monitor overall project cost performance and contingency drawdown
* Lead the project cost close\-out process
* Act as Cost Focal Point for all assigned project scopes


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure project budgets, costs, and reports are documented, auditable, and issued in a controlled manner
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports in accordance with project reporting requirements
* Attend project and client periodic meetings and present cost performance status as required
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and issued in accordance with the contract reporting calendar
* Ensure original and current budgets correspond to approved estimates and scope changes throughout the project lifecycle
* Participate in contract and corporate risk analysis sessions and audits


 PMBS \& Efficiency
   

  

* Support the achievement of the contract PMBS efficiency target (target: PMBS below 50% of Engineering cost)
* Actively contribute to simplification of cost reporting structures and reduction of unnecessary reporting overhead
* Contribute to the development of fit\-for\-purpose cost controls for the Fast Track delivery model


 Team \& Capability Development
   

  

* Supervise, guide, and manage the Cost team — delegating work, reviewing outputs, and supporting development
* Play a key role in mentoring and career development of cost personnel within the GEC
* Lead and participate in Project Controls compliance and continuous improvement reviews
* Contribute to the recruiting and retention of project controls talent within the GEC Hub


**Contract\-specific Requirements**
 Location \& Mobility
   

  

* Based at the Wood GEC office in Chennai, India — this is the primary place of work
* Willingness and ability to undertake periodic overseas travel, primarily to the UK (Aberdeen), for project governance, knowledge transfer, customer engagement, and team alignment purposes
* Estimated overseas travel: low frequency (approximately 2–4 trips per year depending on project phase)


 International \& Multicultural Experience
   

  

* Demonstrated experience working in multicultural environments — experience working or collaborating with teams in Europe (particularly the UK) is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to operate effectively across cultural, organizational, and time\-zone boundaries
* Experience of UK North Sea or comparable European offshore oil and gas operations is advantageous


 Brownfield Experience
   

  

* Preference for candidates with previous brownfield offshore modification or brownfield EPC project experience
* Familiarity with the particular challenges of brownfield scope definition, execution in operating environments, and interface management with asset operations teams


 Transition \& Uncertainty Leadership
   

  

* Demonstrable ability to lead teams through periods of significant change, transition, and operating model evolution
* Comfortable operating with managed uncertainty — able to keep teams focused, motivated, and delivering during periods when processes, structures, or accountabilities are still maturing
* Experience of operating model transitions, onboarding programmes, or significant organizational change is advantageous


 Workload Flexibility
   

  

* Ability to manage varied and changing workloads across multiple concurrent scopes of differing scale and complexity
* Comfortable moving between strategic planning, hands\-on delivery support, and team leadership as the situation requires


 Networking \& Talent Development
   

  

* Strong professional networking capability — able to identify, attract, and retain talent within the GEC and the wider Wood organization
* Active approach to building an internal talent pipeline, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to the development of the GEC as a center of excellence
* Contribution to the wider recruiting effort for the GEC Hub build\-out is expected


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business discipline (or equivalent through relevant vocational training and industry experience)


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant cost control experience
* Excellent knowledge of cost software, budgeting, forecasting, and cash\-flow management
* Advanced knowledge of Project Execution Procedures for Cost Management including Change Management
* Excellent understanding of WBS and CBS structures, earned value application, and cost/schedule variance analysis
* Prior experience in a senior cost role, with team management experience
* Experience of offshore oil and gas project delivery — brownfield experience strongly preferred


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Analytically rigorous with strong attention to accuracy and auditability
* Proactive communicator — raises issues early and clearly
* Able to work autonomously and within a team across multiple time zones
* Committed to continuous improvement and process simplification
* Strong organizational and planning skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent scopes

 Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

title: AVP - Treasury PC
description:
Become part of Barclays as AVP \- Treasury Product Control, where purpose of the role is perform Analytical review of securities, fees and investment income for investment banking business. This includes understanding the nature of each business, explaining the movements in Balance sheet/P\&L, identifying the control gaps. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating.
   

  

**To Be Successful, In This Role You Should Have**
* Product control experience in Investment bank.
* In\-depth knowledge of Financial product and markets of the relevant governance control.
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end processes of an IB (Investment Banking) and associated controls.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings and the ability to interact.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* CFA / Masters in Finance / Financial Engineering.
* Good control awareness and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently with a spectrum of people from junior finance staff to front office business heads.
* Mature and able to negotiate through difficult situations.
* Good influencing and negotiation skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P\&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P\&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Skills \& Other Requirements**
 Should have managed a team of 10\-15 members First or second level management expertise required Candidate should demonstrate problem solving skills, conducting specialized research and analysis of complex securities pricing issues Must have considerable domain knowledge preferably in areas of Pricing or Valuations with good product knowledge across Equity, Fixed Income, and Derivatives. Senior\-level communication skills, presentation skills, prior experience of interacting with multiple stakeholders Highly organized with ability to multi\-task and work under high pressure deadlines Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word) Strong working knowledge of Bloomberg , Reuters and IDC The candidate must have well\-developed analytical skills. title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level
   

  

 F
   

  

 EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
**Manager – Financial Operations**
 The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.
   

  

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**
* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.


**People Management**
* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.


**Accounts Payable Operations**
* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.


**Record\-to\-Report Operations**
* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.


**Procurement Operations**
* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.


**Payroll Operations (UK)**
* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.


**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**
* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.


**Performance Management \& Reporting**
* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**
 The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:
   

  

**EXPERIENCE:**
* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.


**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**
* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent


**SKILLS:**
* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.


 We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre\-employment screening checks.

title: Asset Manager
description:
Step into the role of Asset Manager at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules \& regulations, and codes of conduct.
   

  

 You will focus on supporting and overseeing credit documentation and managing the execution of lending transactions while ensuring compliance with legal and operational requirements. The role requires strong stakeholder engagement, proactive coordination with clients and business teams, and driving deals to closure through effective communication and decision making within Barclays.

* Review and manage credit and legal documentation to support smooth execution of lending transactions.
* Coordinate with clients, legal teams, and internal stakeholders to obtain necessary approvals and resolve documentation related queries.
* Analyse legal drafts and ensure alignment with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.
* Identify risks, escalate issues appropriately, and ensure all processes are completed within agreed timelines.
* Act as a key point of contact for stakeholders, providing updates and driving timely closure of deals.


**Desirable Skills Set**
* Strong experience in credit documentation and lending operations.
* Good understanding of legal terminology, contracts, and documentation review processes.
* Assertive personality with strong negotiation and problem\-solving abilities..
* Excellent stakeholder management, client handling, and communication skills.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented mindset with a strong focus on execution and delivery.


 You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Chennai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To support Wholesale Lending with day\-to\-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Support with day\-to\-day Wholesale Lending initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution through lending technical expertise.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

description:

 We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven MetricStream Delivery Lead to oversee the successful delivery of MetricStream solutions at Glencore. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams across multiple locations globally.
   

  

**The main tasks and responsibilities include:**
* Lead the delivery of MetricStream implementation at Glencore, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including IT, business stakeholders, and external vendors, to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.

* Monitor project progress to plan, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely delivery.
* Facilitate regular project meetings to communicate status, address challenges and escalations as necessary.
* Ensure adherence to best practices and standards in project management and GRC implementations.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to team members, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance environment.


**Technical Experience:**
* Degree (e.g., BA, BSc) or professional certifications in computer science, Information technology, or a related field.
* 10\+ years’ experience delivering and managing MetricStream implementations in global organizations.
* Proven experience as a delivery lead, preferably with MetricStream or similar GRC platforms.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on delivering results.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written \& ability to collaborate across departments and cultures
* Knowledge of MetricStream features and technology (BAPI journeys, PL\-SQL, JAVA and MetricStream reporting tools, Power BI etc.)
* Knowledge of data governance and the integration of Risk, Audit, and HSEC processes.


**Key strengths include:**
* A solutions\-focused individual who can work with teams through complex challenges while maintaining clarity on priorities and outcomes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar certification is a plus.
* Familiarity with compliance, risk management, and audit processes.
* Awareness of natural resources sector compliance challenges and emerging GRC \& ERM trends, is a plus.


**Benefits**
* We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.
* We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.
* We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.
