title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.

title: Deputy Manager- Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Responsibilities:**
 We are looking for a dynamic Trade Execution \& Port Operations professional to manage end\-to\-end execution of edible oil imports and domestic trade operations. The role will be responsible for execution of import and local purchase contracts, vessel operations, customs coordination, terminal operations, inventory management, customer deliveries, documentation, cost control, and stakeholder management across multiple ports including JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and Haldia.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in handling imported edible oils such as Crude Palm Oil (CPO), Degummed Soybean Oil (DSO), Sunflower Oil, RBD and other bulk liquid commodities.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Trade Execution
   

  

* Manage complete execution of purchase and sales contracts from contract confirmation until final settlement.
* Ensure timely execution of import shipments with minimal operational and financial risk.
* Coordinate contract nominations, shipment schedules, delivery plans, and execution timelines.
* Monitor contractual obligations and ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms.
* Maintain accurate trade position and execution status.


 Port \& Terminal Operations
   

  

* Independently manage day\-to\-day operations at JNPT, Chennai, Mangalore, and other assigned ports.
* Coordinate vessel discharge operations with shipping agents, tank terminals, surveyors, customs brokers, and transporters.
* Monitor vessel berthing, discharge progress, storage utilization, and cargo evacuation.
* Ensure timely completion of discharge operations while minimizing demurrage, detention, and operational delays.
* Coordinate local purchase unloading and customer loading operations.


 Customs \& Documentation
   

  

* Track Bill of Entry (BOE) filing and customs clearance.
* Coordinate with Customs House Agents (CHA), shipping lines, and regulatory authorities.
* Monitor duty payments and customs\-related compliance.
* Ensure timely availability of import documents for cargo clearance.


 Customer \& Supplier Coordination
   

  

* Act as the primary execution contact for buyers, suppliers, shipping companies, tank terminals, surveyors, inspectors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate delivery orders, cargo lifting schedules, sampling, inspections, and documentation.
* Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform margin calculations, revised pricing, duty variance calculations, and commercial settlements.
* Process Debit Notes (DN), Credit Notes (CN), and trade settlements.
* Verify invoices before processing


 Inventory \& Quality Management
   

  

* Monitor stock positions across terminals.
* Coordinate quality inspections, sampling, and survey reports.
* Ensure accurate inventory reconciliation.
* Coordinate quality and weight settlements with suppliers and buyers while minimizing commercial exposure.
* Monitor execution costs and identify opportunities for operational savings.
* Review port, terminal, survey, transport, and warehouse costs.
* Support vendor invoice verification and non\-raw material vendor payments.


 Reporting \& MIS, Process Improvement \& Compliance
   

  

* Maintain execution records and operational documentation.
* Prepare Daily Discharge Reports (DDR), vessel status reports, stock reports, and execution MIS.
* Update SharePoint and ERP systems with execution data.
* Prepare month\-end operational reports and support financial closing activities.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, trade compliance, food safety, and statutory requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining complete documentation.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Trading, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Customs, and Legal teams.
* Build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, terminals, surveyors, transporters, shipping agents, and government authorities.
* Maintain accurate execution records.
* Support ERP implementation and digital initiatives.
* Perform additional execution\-related responsibilities assigned by management.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Timely execution of purchase and sales contracts.
* Zero operational disruptions due to execution lapses.
* Minimized demurrage, detention, and avoidable logistics costs.
* Accurate BOE tracking and customs clearance.
* Timely customer deliveries and cargo lifting.
* Inventory accuracy and stock reconciliation.
* Timely completion of commercial settlements (DN/CN).
* Accuracy of MIS and operational reporting.
* Strong compliance with SOPs and audit requirements.
* Continuous improvement through cost\-saving and process optimization initiatives.


**Your Profile**
 Preferred Experience
   

  

* 5–10 years of experience in Trade Execution, Import Operations, Port Operations, or Supply Chain.
* Experience in edible oil imports is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience managing bulk liquid cargo operations.
* Experience handling multiple ports simultaneously.


**Preferred Commodity Experience**
* Crude Palm Oil (CPO) /Crude Deggumed Soybean Oil /Refined Oils /Crude Sunflower Oil /Other edible oil commodities

As a Product Strategy and Operations Manager, you will work closely with the Product Strategy and Operations Manager and the Product leadership team, partnering across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Finance. This is an ideal first role for a fresh MBA graduate who wants exposure to how a fast\-scaling product organisation actually runs — you'll learn by doing, with real ownership from day one.
 



 You will:
 


* Support the P\&E rhythm of business — helping coordinate roadmap reviews, sprint planning, launch readiness, post\-launch retrospectives, and QBRs — and help build the operating cadence that keeps the product organisation structured and predictable.
* Help track the product metrics that matter: activation, adoption, retention, expansion, and their leading indicators. Assist in building out the "product landing" framework — a structured post\-launch process that ensures new features are actually adopted and generate learnings for the next iteration.
* Support the product\-level analysis of pricing and packaging — how capabilities are bundled, how value is communicated at each tier, and how new AI modules affect the overall commercial model.
* Assist Finance and Sales on pricing changes — building models of customer impact and helping structure the internal and external communication around pricing evolution.
* Help develop ROI frameworks and value metrics for each product area, which Marketing and Sales can use in positioning and commercial conversations.
* Support the sales enablement process — working with Sales and Marketing to help set targets, build plans, and track tactics that drive pipeline generation, CSAT, and adoption.
* Help build and maintain competitive intelligence systems that give product leaders an up\-to\-date view of the market landscape.



**What We're Looking For** 



* 7\+ years of Product Management or related experience, with atleast 3 years focused on Unified Endpoint Management, Mobile Device management (MDM), or enterprise security solutions.

 **ISB, IIMs, or equivalent institutions** 
 , with a specialization or strong interest in
 **Strategy, Operations, Product Management, or General Management** 
 .

* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with comfort working with data to build frameworks, dashboards, and business cases.

* High ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and comfort operating with ambiguity — the kind of environment typical of an early\-stage, fast\-scaling product organisation.

title: Plant Manager / Production Manager
description:
For our Client:
 



  





 Chemical Blending Facility – Speciality Chemicals
 



  





 Position Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager / Production Manager to lead the setup, commissioning, and ongoing operations of a chemical blending facility for the manufacture of detergents, surfactants, and dicing fluids. The role will be responsible for safe, efficient, quality\-driven, and compliant plant operations, including production planning, batch manufacturing, raw material handling, packaging, maintenance coordination, manpower management, and continuous improvement.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will bring strong hands\-on experience in chemical blending, specialty chemicals, surfactants, detergents, lubricants, process chemicals, personal care chemicals, or related formulation\-based manufacturing environments, along with proven leadership of plant teams and adherence to safety, quality, and statutory requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead day\-to\-day production operations for chemical blending, mixing, filtration, filling, packaging, storage, and dispatch activities.
 



 Manage plant setup activities including layout readiness, equipment installation support, utilities coordination, trial batches, commissioning, and operational handover.
 



 Ensure all batches are manufactured strictly as per approved formulations, batch sheets, SOPs, work instructions, and quality specifications.
 



 Plan production schedules based on customer requirements, raw material availability, manpower, equipment capacity, and delivery commitments.
 



 Supervise handling, storage, charging, transfer, and use of chemicals including surfactants, solvents, additives, builders, preservatives, pH adjusters, fragrances, and specialty performance additives.
 



 Maintain strong control over batch yields, rework, wastage, spillage, process losses, and product consistency.
 



 Coordinate closely with Quality Control / Quality Assurance for raw material release, in\-process checks, finished product testing, non\-conformance handling, and corrective actions.
 



 Implement and enforce EHS practices related to chemical handling, PPE, MSDS/SDS compliance, spill response, fire safety, hazardous storage, effluent control, and emergency preparedness.
 



 Maintain compliance with applicable factory, labour, environmental, statutory, ISO, customer, and internal audit requirements.
 



 Lead, train, schedule, and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, helpers, and contract employees across shifts.
 



 Coordinate with maintenance and engineering teams to ensure preventive maintenance, breakdown response, calibration, utility reliability, and equipment uptime.
 



 Monitor production performance using KPIs such as output, batch cycle time, right\-first\-time quality, OEE, downtime, yield, cost, rejection rate, and on\-time delivery.
 



 Maintain accurate plant documentation, including batch records, production reports, stock records, shift logs, equipment cleaning records, EHS records, and audit trails.
 



 Drive continuous improvement initiatives in productivity, safety, housekeeping, process standardization, material usage, energy efficiency, and cost reduction.
 



 Support procurement, stores, warehouse, logistics, R\&D, technical service, and commercial teams to ensure smooth end\-to\-end operations.
 



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 



 Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Polymer Science, Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 



 Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in chemical manufacturing, preferably in chemical blending, detergents, surfactants, specialty chemicals, metalworking fluids, dicing fluids, lubricants, process chemicals, home care, personal care, coatings, adhesives, or similar formulation\-based industries.
 



 At least 3–5 years of experience in a supervisory or managerial production role with responsibility for teams, shifts, production targets, safety, and quality outcomes.
 



 Experience in plant startup, commissioning, scale\-up, process stabilization, or greenfield / brownfield expansion projects will be highly preferred.
 



 Strong working knowledge of batch processing, blending vessels, agitators, pumps, transfer lines, filtration systems, filling lines, storage tanks, weighing systems, utilities, and packaging operations.
 



 Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, 5S, lean manufacturing, and statutory compliance requirements applicable to chemical plants.
 



 Technical Competencies
 



 Understanding of surfactant chemistry, detergent formulations, emulsions, pH control, viscosity control, foam behaviour, compatibility, and stability requirements.
 



 Knowledge of chemical blending methods, batch sequencing, raw material compatibility, and contamination prevention.
 



 Ability to read and implement formulations, batch manufacturing records, process parameters, SOPs, SDS/MSDS documents, and quality specifications.
 



 Strong awareness of safe storage and handling of acids, alkalis, solvents, surfactants, preservatives, additives, and other industrial chemicals.
 



 Working knowledge of effluent, waste, spill, and emissions management practices relevant to chemical blending facilities.
 



 Ability to troubleshoot production issues such as off\-spec batches, phase separation, foaming, viscosity deviation, contamination, colour / odour variation, filling losses, and equipment downtime.
 



 Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
 



 Strong leadership, ownership, discipline, and hands\-on plant\-floor orientation.
 



 Ability to build and lead teams in a startup or scale\-up manufacturing environment.
 



 High commitment to safety, quality, compliance, housekeeping, and operational reliability.
 



 Good communication skills for coordination with senior management, technical teams, vendors, auditors, customers, and shop\-floor employees.
 



 Strong problem\-solving ability with a practical, data\-driven, and cost\-conscious approach.
 



 Ability to create systems, enforce SOPs, train teams, and sustain operational discipline.
 



 Key Performance Indicators
 



 Achievement of monthly and weekly production plans.
 



 Right\-first\-time batch quality and reduction in non\-conformances.
 



 Improvement in yield, productivity, batch cycle time, and equipment uptime.
 



 Reduction in wastage, rework, spills, downtime, and customer complaints.
 



 Compliance with EHS, statutory, audit, and documentation requirements.
 



 Manpower productivity, training completion, retention, and discipline.
 



 On\-time availability of finished goods for dispatch.
 



 Reporting and Interfaces
 



 Reports to: Business Head
 



 Preferred Candidate Profile
 



 The preferred candidate will be a practical, technically strong, safety\-conscious production leader who has grown through plant operations and understands both formulation accuracy and shop\-floor execution. The person should be comfortable working in a hands\-on environment, setting up systems from scratch, leading teams across shifts, and ensuring that the facility operates with high standards of quality, discipline, compliance, and cost control.
 



  





 Location \- Chennai
 



  





 Budget \- Open

title: Associate / Assistant manager - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Position Overview"** 




  




* **Job Title:** 
 Associate / Assistant manager \- Transaction Reporting
* **Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations
* **Location:** 
 Chennai
* **Business Line / Function:** 
 Reporting Production Analyst – Regulatory Transaction Reporting (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite)



  





**Position Purpose:** 




  





 Execute day‑to‑day regulatory transaction reporting across EU and UK jurisdictions (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II) and ASIC Rewrite. Serve as the first‑line defence to ensure accurate, complete and timely submission to Trade Repositories or Approved Reporting Mechanisms, while overseeing outsourced reporting providers and delegated broker reports.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




  





 1\. Oversight \& Monitoring of Outsourced Reporting (EMIR EU/UK, ASIC)
 


* Monitor daily production and submission status of the 3rd‑party service provider (SP).
* Validate SP controls, reconcile internal trades against SP reports, and track escalations or SLA breaches.
* Maintain audit evidence and act as the primary SP point‑of‑contact.



 2\. Daily Trade \& Transaction Reporting (SFTR \& MiFID II – EU/UK)
 


* Produce and submit all reportable trades within regulatory deadlines.
* Monitor platforms and intraday flows, validate post‑submission content, and ensure final acceptance by the Trade Repository or ARM/APA.



 3\. Rejections \& Exceptions Remediation
 


* Investigate NACKs and other exceptions; identify root causes (data quality, mapping, reference data, timing).
* Amend and resubmit corrected reports within the required jurisdictional timeframes.
* Keep a detailed audit trail of all remediation actions.



 4\. Daily \& Monthly Reconciliation
 


* Perform daily reconciliation for SFTR and MiFID II (EU/UK) and reconcile internal data against SP output for EMIR and ASIC.
* Conduct monthly reconciliations to confirm consistency between source data and submitted data.
* Document results and escalate any unresolved breaks with a clear resolution plan.



 5\. Oversight of Delegated EMIR Reporting on ETD (Clearing Brokers)
 


* Validate the completeness and timeliness of broker‑submitted reports.
* Engage brokers to correct discrepancies, track issues and retain audit evidence.



 6\. Pairing \& Matching
 


* Resolve unpaired or unmatched transactions; manage UTI processing in line with internal procedures.
* Monitor pairing and matching rates as a key quality indicator.



 7\. Reporting to RTR Team
 


* Produce daily dashboards covering volumes, pairing/matching rates, acceptance, rejections and remediation.
* Highlight emerging issues, trends and risks in a structured manner.



**8\. Continuous Improvement \& Knowledge Sharing** 



* Identify and escalate recurring issues; keep procedures, run‑books and knowledge base up‑to‑date.
* Cross‑train team members to maintain full interchangeability.
* Stay current with regulatory changes and contribute to impact assessments.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience (must have):** 




  




* **Regulatory Reporting Experience:** 
 Minimum
 **(Associate \- 3\-6 years)**
* **( Assistant Manager 7\- 11 years)** 
 in regulatory transaction reporting within financial services (asset‑management or sell‑side).
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** 
 Solid understanding of reporting mechanics (submission lifecycles, ACK/NACK handling, UTI, pairing‑matching, lifecycle events) and proficiency in at least one regime (EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite) with a willingness to master all four.
* **Outsourced‑Provider Oversight:** 
 Proven ability to monitor, challenge and review controls and SLAs of an external reporting provider.
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Advanced Excel (pivot tables, look‑ups, conditional logic) for reconciliation and reporting.
* **Analytical \& Investigative Skills:** 
 Strong root‑cause analysis of data‑quality issues.
* **Communication:** 
 Ability to translate technical issues into clear messages for the RTR team and senior management; capable of producing presentations and KPI reports.
* **Team Interchangeability:** 
 Support colleagues through documentation, knowledge sharing and active collaboration.
* **Behavioral Skills:** 
 Active listening, adaptability, knowledge sharing and meticulous attention to details



  





**Preferred Education, Skills \& Experience :** 




  




* **Regulatory Regimes:** 
 Working knowledge of two or more of the following – EMIR Refit, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC Rewrite.
* **Reporting Platforms:** 
 Hands‑on experience with Aladdin, TRAX (ARM/APA), Tri‑Optima, DTCC or IHS Markit.
* **Additional Technical Tools:** 
 Familiarity with automated reconciliation or data‑quality tools (e.g., Python‑based scripting, SQL) – advantageous but not mandatory.

 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group.
